title: Round-trip identity — V3 classic container with a classic heading widget child
_comment: WP-Q05 (14-fixtures-harness.md §7). V3 CLASSIC fallback generation: a `container` element (flat settings map, NO typed envelopes) wrapping a classic `heading` widget (widgetType must NOT start with `e-`). build → get_structure → normalize(both) → assert structural equality. Classic nodes have no `styles`/`_cssid` (those are atomic-only) so the normalizer's atomic tolerances are no-ops here; the only normalization is dropping the empty `elements` on the leaf widget. Both ids (container + child) are re-minted on save (C2) so the round-trip test compares ids structurally/positionally, never literally. Classic emits only non-default keys; responsive overrides would use SUFFIX keys (_tablet/_mobile). Run as ADMIN (content-sanitizer exempt). prefilter.verdict:defer (classic flat settings cannot be proven structurally; PHP dry_run authoritative). Proves the round-trip identity guarantee holds for the V3 fallback path as well as the V4 atomic primary.
